address: 157 MCC Road, Ikot Eyo, Calabar

name: The NookHouse
about: The NookHouse is a premium, 4.5-star serviced shortlet apartment building located in a serene, secure residential layout in Calabar, Cross River State, Nigeria. Designed intentionally for both short weekend getaways and extended business stays, the property blends the privacy and comfort of a modern home with upscale, hotel-style hospitality
address: Plot 76 Parliamentary Road Extension, Calabar

name: Farmers Paradise MARKET PLACE
about: Farmers Paradise MARKET PLACE in Calabar is a vibrant hub that serves as both a dynamic agricultural market and a relaxing leisure spot. Conveniently situated along the bustling Murtala Muhammed Highway, it offers an easily accessible location for residents and visitors to source fresh food items or grab a home-cooked meal
address: Farmers Paradise MARKET PLACE,Murtala Muhammed High Way, by technical roundabout, Calabar

name: U.J Esuene Stadium
about: The U.J Esuene Stadium is a historic 16,000-capacity multi-purpose arena located in the heart of Calabar, Cross River State, Nigeria. Opened on April 2, 1977, it serves as a central sporting and community landmark and is the proud home ground of the Calabar Rovers F.C.. Over the decades, it has established a significant legacy by hosting high-profile international football fixtures, including matches for the 1999 FIFA World Youth Championship and the 2009 FIFA U-17 World Cup. Beyond professional football, the stadium serves as a major regional hub for athletics, local sports training, public gatherings, and recreational fitness
address: UJ ESUENE STADIUM, Naval Base, Calabar

name: 520 Kolanut Center
about: 520 Kolanut Center is a premier conference, concert, and event venue located in the Bogobiri neighborhood of Calabar, Cross River. A key member of the 520 Hotels family, it functions as a highly rated state-of-the-art multi-purpose hall that frequently hosts major social events, concerts, religious gatherings, and weddings within the city
address: 5 Barracks Rd, Bogoberi, Calabar

name: Marina Resort
about: The Marina Resort in Calabar is a premier historical and recreational destination situated on the scenic banks of the Calabar River. Built by former governor Donald Duke on May 26, 2007, it blends a tragic, deeply reflective past with a vibrant, modern social atmosphere. The resort is highly regarded as one of Cross River State's top tourist landmarks, offering visitors a mix of historical education, entertainment, and relaxing waterfront views
address: Duke Town, Calabar

name: Tinapa Business and Leisure Resort
about: The Tinapa Business and Leisure Resort is an ambitious 265-hectare business, trade, and tourism complex located just north of Calabar, Cross River State, Nigeria. Envisioned by former Governor Donald Duke and commissioned in 2007, the $350 million mega-project was designed as West Africa’s premier duty-free retail, wholesale, and entertainment hub. After facing complex regulatory hurdles, financial strains, and legal limbos that left it largely underutilized and quiet for years, the resort has hit a major turning point: the Cross River State Government officially reclaimed full ownership from the Asset Management Corporation of Nigeria (AMCON). The state is actively partnering with the Nigeria Export Processing Zones Authority (NEPZA) to fully revitalize the infrastructure, attract global investors, and restore Tinapa to its original glory
address: Tinapa Free Zone & Resort Adiabo, Calabar

name: St. Luke Hospital Calabar
about: St. Luke Hospital Calabar is a private, patient-centred healthcare facility located in the heart of Calabar, Cross River State. Founded and directed by Dr. Patience T. Asor, a specialist in Gynaecology and Obstetrics, the hospital provides premium, compassionate medical services 24/
address: PLOT 97 IBOM LAYOUT, Ndidem Usang Iso Rd, off Marian Road, Big Qua Town, Calabar

name: Arubah Specialist Hospital and Diagnostics
about: Arubah Specialist Hospital and Diagnostics is a registered secondary healthcare facility offering comprehensive clinical and diagnostic services in Calabar, Cross River State. Operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, the private hospital is fully accredited by the National Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS CODE: CR/0159/P) and manages coverage for various Health Maintenance Organizations (HMOs)
address: 23 Nsefik Eyo Close, Off Ndidem Usang Iso Rd, Marian, Calabar

name: Bakor Medical Centre/ Clinic
about: Bakor Medical Centre/ Clinic is the largest private medical practice in Cross River State and serves as one of the major providers for the National Health Insurance Authority (NHIA) in the region. Established in 1989, the facility operates on a 24-hour basis to offer comprehensive primary, secondary, and acute care services
address: No. 124 Murtala Mohammed Highway, opposite NNPC/Oando Station, Federal Housing Estate, Calabar

name: Luciama Memorial Hospital
about: Luciama Memorial Specialist Hospital is a licensed, 20-bed private secondary healthcare facility established on December 12, 2012, in Calabar, Cross River State, Nigeria. The hospital provides 24-hour medical services, specializing in general medical care, eye care, and antenatal/delivery services
address: 9 Bishop Moynagh Avenue, Municipality, Calabar

name: Faith Foundation Specialist Clinic
about: Faith Foundation Specialist Clinic & Maternity is a prominent, privately held medical facility located at 57 Ndidem Usang Iso Road, Calabar, Cross River State, Nigeria. Founded in 1991, this multi-specialty healthcare facility is highly regarded for its comprehensive round-the-clock clinical care, modern infrastructure, and specialized focus on maternal and child health
address: 57 Ndidem Usang Iso Rd, Big Qua Town, Calabar

name: Calabar Women And Children Hospital
about: The Calabar Women and Children Hospital (CWCH) is a multidisciplinary secondary healthcare provider located at 164/165 Murtala Muhammed Highway, Calabar, Cross River State ["0.6.6"]. It stands out as a specialized center for maternal, neonatal, and child health care, partnering globally with institutions like Imperial College London to utilize cutting-edge infant care technologies
address: 164/165 Murtala Muhammed Highway, Calabar

name: General Hospital, Calabar
about: General Hospital, Calabar is a prominent, government-owned secondary healthcare facility located on Mary Slessor Avenue in Calabar, Cross River State. It acts as a major medical anchor for the local community, providing 24-hour emergency care, maternity services, surgery, and general practice medicine
address: Mary Slessor Ave, Efut Ekondo, Calabar

name: Cute Villa Hotel
about: Cute Villa Hotel and Suites is a budget-friendly mid-level hotel located in the serene Ewet Housing Estate in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. Positioned within easy reach of local landmarks like Discovery Park and the Ibibio Museum, the property serves as a functional spot for business travellers and guests looking for a quiet, hidden location to unwind. The hotel features 26 air-conditioned guestrooms, an on-site restaurant and bar, a banquet hall, and round-the-clock front desk assistance
address: 52 G Lane, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo

name: Monty Suites Uyo
about: Monty Suites Uyo is a premium 4-star luxury hotel located in the heart of Uyo, Akwa Ibom. Situated along the bustling General Edet Akpan Avenue (Four Lanes), it stands as one of the city's top hospitality destinations, highly regarded for its serene environment, extensive amenities, and excellent customer service
address: 37 General Edet Akpan Ave, Uyo

name: Aiku Luxury Hotel & Resort
about: Aiku Luxury Hotel & Resort is a premium, contemporary hospitality establishment located along Ring Road 3 (beside Oron Road) in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. Known for blending modern sophistication with top-tier relaxation spaces, it has quickly become a favored destination for both business travelers and leisure seekers in Uyo
address: Ring Rd 3, Uyo

name: Remalex Hotels and Suites Uyo
about: Remalex Hotels and Suites Uyo is a highly rated 4-star boutique hotel located along Idongesit Nkanga Way, Ring Road 3 in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State. It is known for its blend of contemporary style, unique wood-paneled room interiors, and pocket-friendly premium hospitality
address: Idongesit Nkanga Way, Ring Rd 3, Uyo

name: De-Lexis Hotel & Suites
about: De-Lexis Hotel & Suites is a highly-rated 3-star luxury boutique hotel situated along Osong Ama Estate Road in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. It is well-regarded for its contemporary rooms, quiet environment, and comprehensive guest facilities, making it a great destination for both business travellers and leisure seekers visiting the state capital
address: Osong Ama Estate Rd, Iniabasi Udobong Ave, Uyo

name: Rosmohr Gold Hotels
about: Rosmohr Gold Hotels is a highly rated hospitality brand primarily located in the exclusive Ewet Housing Estate in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, rather than Calabar. It features multiple nearby properties within the estate, including Rosmohr Gold 1, Rosmohr Gold 2, and Rosmohr Vintage Hotel, offering a blend of modern luxury and premium hospitality
address: Plot C45, 67 Udo Inyang Close, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo

name: Merzino Palace Hotel
about: The Merzino Palace Hotel is a premium accommodation option located at 4 Akparawa Crescent, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo, Akwa Ibom. It offers amenities such as an indoor pool, a restaurant, a bar, and complimentary breakfast, with room rates starting from ₦49,999 per night
address: 4 Akparawa Cres, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo

name: Greenview Hotel and Apartments
about: Greenview Hotel and Apartments is a highly-rated hospitality venue located in the serene Ewet Housing Extension Estate in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. Combining the comfort of premium hotel rooms with the flexibility of apartment living, it is popular among both business travellers and leisure guests looking for a reliable, upscale stay in Uyo
address: Plot 221, Ewet Housing Extension Estate, Mbak Road, Ring Rd 3, off New, Uyo

name: SIGNATURE BY ROYALTY
about: Signature by Royalty is an upscale, boutique 3.5-star hotel tucked away in the serene, high-end neighborhood of Ewet Housing Estate in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State. Featuring just 10 elegantly appointed rooms, this exclusive property stands out for its quiet, highly comfortable environment, professional staff, and intimate atmosphere that caters beautifully to both business executives and leisure travelers seeking a premium experience away from the city's larger commercial crowds
address: 48 G Line, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo

name: Perly Gate Residence
about: The Perly Gate Residence is a highly rated hospitality establishment located along the Calabar-Itu Highway in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State. It provides a modern lodging experience featuring comfortable accommodations, premium dining, and lively entertainment options like an on-site night club and a sleek poolside lounge.
address: 120 Calabar Itu Hwy, Uyo

name: Fraîche Restaurant
about: If you are looking for an exceptional culinary experience in Akwa Ibom, Fraîche Restaurant (also known as Fraiche Palace Restaurant) in Uyo is a fantastic choice. It beautifully balances a chic, modern ambience with deeply comforting flavors. I highly recommend trying their Fisherman Soup, a true local highlight, though their smoky Jollof rice, Egusi soup, and spicy seafood platters are equally crowd-pleasing. It’s a wonderful spot whether you want a cozy date night, a relaxed brunch, or a reliable place to enjoy premium Nigerian and continental dishes
address: 288 Oron Rd, opposite Nesman Filling station, Uyo

name: Harvard Restaurant and Lounge
about: The Harvard Restaurant and Lounge is a premium fine dining and nightlife hotspot located in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. Known locally as "The Platter King," it blends upscale African, Chinese, and continental cuisines with an energetic lounge atmosphere featuring karaoke, a live band, and painting activities
address: 91 B line, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo

name: The Patio by Kimochii
about: The Patio by Kimochii is a popular fast-casual bistro and outdoor dining spot located at 86 Nsikak Eduok Ave (Two Lanes) in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State. Known for its intimate, cozy, and nature-surrounded ambience, it serves up a variety of comfort foods alongside creative activities like sip-and-paint and sculpting
address: 86 Nsikak Eduok Ave, 2lanes, Uyo

name: The Outback Grill
about: The Outback Grill is one of the trendiest outdoor spots in Uyo, known for its vibrant ambiance, urban contemporary house and jazz tunes, and excellent proteins. Located in the upscale Ewet Housing Estate area, it offers a great blend of casual nightlife, entertainment like karaoke, and high-quality grilled food
address: Plot 4 C-Line, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo

name: Brisa Place
about: Brisa Place is a premier modern African kitchen, bar, and lounge located in the upscale Ewet Housing Estate in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria. Known for its gorgeous boho-Afrocentric aesthetics, rich seafood platters, and high-energy nightlife, it has quickly become one of the city's top spots for everything from romantic dinner dates to late-night weekend vibes
address: House 31 C line, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo

name: Nosh bistro
about: De Nosh Bistro is a modern, stylish restaurant and lounge located in the upscale Ewet Housing Estate area of Uyo, Akwa Ibom State. Opening its doors as a fresh hangout spot, it has quickly earned a glowing reputation for its beautiful aesthetic, vibrant casual dining atmosphere, and exceptionally affordable craft food and cocktails
address: Udo Inyang Close, Ewet Housing Estate, Uyo

name: Moscow Uyo
about: If you are looking for an upscale, high-energy dining spot in Akwa Ibom, Moscow Uyo is one of the premier luxury restaurants and nightlife lounges in Uyo. Located right along the bustling 148 General Edet Akpan Avenue (Four Lane), it has quickly gained a reputation for its striking, multi-tier aesthetic and premium dining experience
address: 148 General Edet Akpan Ave, Uyo
